title: Measures to Facilitate and Expedite Entry of Migrant Domestic Workers to Meet Demand
what_it_is: Measures to Facilitate and Expedite Entry of Migrant Domestic Workers to Meet Demand

sections.label: MDW entry approvals tightened
sections.summary: Entry approvals for MDWs were tightened from May 2021, cutting monthly arrivals from 3,400 to 900, and new applications for fully-vaccinated MDWs opened from 15 October 2021.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: To manage COVID-19 importation risk, entry approvals for MDWs were tightened since May 2021, resulting in the number of MDWs entering Singapore being reduced from an average of 3,400 per month from January to April this year to 900 per month from May to October.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: From 15 October 2021 onwards, we have opened up new applications for the entry of fully-vaccinated MDWs for entry from 1 November and after.

sections.label: AEAS MDW entries
sections.summary: By end of October 2021, the AEAS initiative had facilitated entry of more than 1,000 MDWs from the Philippines, Indonesia and Myanmar.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As at end of October 2021, the AEAS initiative has facilitated the entry of more than 1,000 MDWs from the Philippines, Indonesia and Myanmar.

sections.label: Transfer MDW salary increase
sections.summary: The average monthly salary of transfer MDWs rose from $630 last year to $660 as of September 2021, an increase of about $30.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The average monthly salary of transfer MDW was $630 last year and has increased to $660 as of September 2021; so, about a monthly increase of $30.

sections.label: MDWs waiting to enter
sections.summary: Several thousands of MDWs are waiting to enter Singapore over the next three months, and the entry approval quota will be reviewed to clear as many as possible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On the number of MDWs who are waiting to enter Singapore for the next three months, there are several thousands.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As I have said earlier on, we are committed to continue to look at increasing the entry approval quota, together with our MTF colleagues, so that we can clear as many MDWs to come in as possible for the next three months.

sections.label: MDW arrivals from Indonesia Philippines
sections.summary: For the past few months, the bulk of the 900 MDWs entering Singapore each month were from Indonesia and the Philippines.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Fortunately, for the past few months, the bulk of the 900 per month who entered Singapore were from Indonesia as well as the Philippines.

sections.label: AEAS extends to Myanmar India
sections.summary: The AEAS option already extends to Myanmar and will soon extend to India as well.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Again, the AEAS option already extends to Myanmar and, soon, to India as well.
